name: Marrakech
paragraphs: The station file is MARRAKECH, WMO 60230, height 464 m, position 31°36′40″N, 8°01′43″W. Rabat's coastal numbers are on the Morocco sheet and were not mixed in.

The highest average high in the table is 37.7 °C, in July. The lowest average low is 5.9 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is March, at 35.2 mm, and the driest is July, at 2.2 mm.

climate.caption: Station: Marrakech, WMO 60230.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and E, 127 V and 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Morocco at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read. The line lists two voltages and does not say which city uses which, so this sheet does not either.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Morocco, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Moroccan Dirham and the code MAD for Morocco.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Morocco one row, Africa/Casablanca. There is no second zone for the country in either file.
